$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-SCOPE-GAP-SILENT
arms.note: a scope declaring resolutionLibs and no resolutionRoots goes back to saying nothing, so a narrow --fix on such a project writes the orphan the cross-scope repairs were built to refuse and no byte of output warns that the proofs had nothing to widen into

arms.name: M-ORACLE-UNKNOWN-COVERAGE-NO-VETO
arms.note: a configuration whose compiled set is unknown is dropped from the post-edit typecheck, so an edit that compiles on the covering build and breaks the unknown one is applied although its green baseline makes the rejection attributable

arms.name: M-EFFECTIVE-IGNORES-CONFIG
arms.note: the listing reads the registry defaults and never the config, so a disabled rule is reported as run

arms.name: M-EFFECTIVE-IGNORES-DEFAULT-OFF
arms.note: an opt-in rule no config enables is listed as on

arms.name: M-EFFECTIVE-IGNORES-VERSION
arms.find: final gated: Bool = enabled && minimum != null && !config.allowsLanguageVersion(minimum);
arms.note: a rule whose findings the languageVersion gate drops is listed as on

arms.name: M-EFFECTIVE-GROUPS-PER-DIR
arms.note: two directories under one chain are listed as two groups

arms.name: M-CHAIN-NEAREST-ONLY
arms.note: the nearest apqlint.json replaces its ancestors instead of extending them

arms.name: M-CHAIN-IGNORES-INHERIT
arms.note: a document declaring inherit:false still folds its ancestors

arms.name: M-CHAIN-UNBOUNDED
arms.note: the chain climbs past the project root and folds a stray ancestor document

arms.name: M-GATE-COLLECT-BYPASS
arms.note: the run ignores the FileGated answer the listing reports, so an excluded file is scanned

arms.name: M-EFFECTIVE-IGNORES-FILEGATE
arms.find: final skipped: Null<String> = enabled && !gated && check is FileGated ? (cast check: FileGated).skipReason(file, config) : null;
arms.note: the listing ignores a rule's own per-file gate

arms.name: M-EFFECTIVE-RENDER-HEADER
arms.note: the header review tooling detects the scoped form by changes

arms.name: M-FIXVERIFY-DISCOVERS-CONFIG
arms.note: the risky checks' file gate resolves each file's config by an unmemoised discover instead of the run's resolver

arms.name: M-FIXVERIFY-CHECK-DISCOVERS-CONFIG
arms.note: a ConfigAware risky check reads its own options by an unmemoised discover instead of the run's resolver

arms.name: M-TS-GRAPH-CUT
arms.find: if (!(check is GraphScoped) || reported.length == 0) return reported;
arms.note: a graph-scoped rule reads only the files it reports in, so a file without sinks loses its spawns registrations

arms.name: M-TS-REPORT-UNGATED
arms.find: return found.filter(v -> v.file == '' || gated.skipReason(v.file, LintConfig.resolveWith(resolveConfig, v.file)) == null);
arms.note: a graph-scoped rule's findings in a file its report gate refuses are kept, so a file whose chain writes no option reports findings of its own

arms.name: M-PARENS-QUOTED-DROPPED
arms.note: no rule declines the quotation drop, so redundant-parens reports and fixes nothing inside a macro quotation

arms.name: M-COLLECT-NO-ENABLEMENT
arms.find: resolveConfig == null ? kept : gatedPerFile(kept, checks, resolveConfig, applyEnablement)
arms.note: no path that writes a fix honours a file's own enabled:false

arms.name: M-FIXVERIFY-ENABLEMENT-DROPPED
arms.note: the risky verifier rewrites a file whose config disables the rule

arms.name: M-VERSION-LIFTED-BY-RULE
arms.note: an explicit --rule selection lifts the languageVersion floor, so a fix writes syntax the project cannot compile

arms.name: M-LINT-SUMMARY-THRESHOLD-UNREAD
arms.note: an apqlint.json reportSummaryThreshold is ignored and every run summarises at the default

arms.name: M-REFLECTIVE-MERGE
arms.note: a nested document that leaves `reflectiveClasses` unsaid drops the ancestor's declaration

arms.name: M-HOLDERS-MERGE
arms.note: a nested document that leaves `reflectiveMethodHolders` unsaid drops the ancestor's declaration

arms.name: M-HOLDERS-PARSE
arms.note: `reflectiveMethodHolders` is never read out of `apqlint.json`

arms.name: M-WRITER-NARROW-NONE
arms.find: ? writerNarrowed(entry, edits, message, plugin, opts, usable, excluded, write, rounds)
arms.note: a risky edit set the writer refuses is reverted whole again, so its writable units go with the refused one

arms.name: M-FIXVERIFY-BATCH-NONE
arms.note: every candidate of a risky check is typechecked alone again, so a check whose edits all build costs one oracle round per file

arms.name: M-FIXVERIFY-BATCH-NO-SPLIT
arms.force: [for (c in candidates) judgeAlone(c, plugin, write, rounds)]
arms.note: a rejected batch is judged file by file instead of in halves, so the halves holding no failing file are no longer kept in one round

arms.name: M-FIXVERIFY-BATCH-NO-RESTORE
arms.note: files a rejected batch did not keep stay on disk at their candidate text, so a file judged alone afterwards is confirmed or rejected against edits that were never kept

arms.name: M-FIXVERIFY-BATCH-UNAVAILABLE-SPLITS
arms.note: a batch the oracle could not judge at all is split into halves and asked again, spending rounds on a compiler that cannot run

arms.name: M-OWNED-MERGE
arms.note: a nested document that leaves `ownedTypes` unsaid drops the ancestor's declarations

arms.name: M-OWNED-PARSE
arms.note: `ownedTypes` is never read out of `apqlint.json`

arms.name: M-FIXVERIFY-RISKYARM-FIX
arms.note: the verifier asks a RiskyArm check for its SAFE fix, which declines the arm's findings

arms.name: M-LINT-SUPERSEDES-IGNORED
arms.note: naming and no-underscore-prefix both report the same underscore-prefixed binding

arms.name: M-XVERIFY-NO-MERGE
arms.note: edit sets sharing a file are judged apart, over spans the other one moved

arms.name: M-RISKYARM-CROSS-NOT-VERIFIED
arms.note: the verifier never runs the cross-file arm

arms.name: M-XVERIFY-NO-BISECT
arms.note: one failing rename reverts every rename of its component

arms.name: M-REACH-COMPLETE-FOLLOWS-LIST
arms.note: a nested document naming a compilerOracle list of its own inherits the completeness its ancestor declared for another list, so the reach analysis reads a partial list as every build the project ships

arms.name: M-CATEGORY-OUTRANKS-RULE
find: if (byRule != null) return { on: byRule, byCategory: false };
if (byCategory != null) return { on: byCategory, byCategory: true };
replace:
if (byCategory != null) return { on: byCategory, byCategory: true };
		if (byRule != null) return { on: byRule, byCategory: false };
arms.note: inside one document the category entry is asked before the rule's own entry, so a rule switched on by name inside a disabled category stays off

arms.name: M-CATEGORY-IGNORED
arms.find: final byCategory: Null<Bool> = category == null ? null : level.categories[category];
arms.note: the categories section is never asked, so enabling a category switches none of its default-off members on and disabling it switches nothing off

arms.name: M-RULE-SHORTHAND-DROPPED
arms.note: a true / false rule entry is no entry, so the boolean shorthand switches nothing

arms.name: M-OPTIONS-OBJECT-INERT
arms.find: { enabled: enabled ?? true, severity: severity, props: props };
arms.replace: { enabled: enabled, severity: severity, props: props };
arms.note: an object of options states no enablement, so it no longer enables a default-off rule

arms.name: M-UNKNOWN-CATEGORY-SILENT
arms.note: a misspelt category id is dropped without the diagnostic that names it

arms.name: M-CATEGORIES-NOT-INHERITED
arms.note: a nested document drops every rule and category switch of the documents above it instead of deferring to them for what it does not name

arms.name: M-CHAIN-WIDE-RULE-ENTRY
arms.find: final byCategory: Null<Bool> = category == null ? null : level.categories[category];
arms.replace: final byCategory: Null<Bool> = category == null || Lambda.exists(_switches, l -> l.rules[id] != null) ? null : level.categories[category];
arms.note: a rule entry anywhere in the chain outranks a category entry anywhere in it, so a nested category no longer overrides an outer config's entry for one of its rules

arms.name: M-LANGUAGE-BOUND-RUNS-EVERYWHERE
arms.note: a check bound to one grammar runs on every grammar, so a Haxe standard-library rule reads a JSON or Mermaid tree

arms.name: M-LANGUAGE-COLUMN-ANY
arms.find: return check is LanguageBound ? (cast check: LanguageBound).languages().join(', ') : 'any';
arms.note: the rule listings call a language-bound rule one that runs on every grammar

arms.name: M-FIXVERIFIER-NAMES-NOT-INSTALLED
arms.note: the verified pass hands no name oracle to the rules that ask one, so no value site is ever rewritten
